create.name: Sarah Bamford Seidelmann
create.bio:
Sarah Bamford Seidelmann is a shamanic healer, coach, writer and artist who spent close to twenty years as a pathologist before changing course. Curiosity about what keeps people well, rather than what makes them ill, led her into shamanism and into creative work, guided, as she tells it, by a spirit ally in the form of an elephant called Alice. She completed the Foundation for Shamanic Studies' three-year programme in advanced initiations, trained in Alberto Villoldo's Light Body school, and qualified as a coach with the Martha Beck Institute, where she later taught on the Wayfinder training.

Today she offers shamanic healing ceremonies, shamanic mentoring for people working with their own helping spirits, and life coaching, in person or at a distance. Her short recorded class Get Sourced introduces the shamanic journey for beginners, and with Inger Kenobi she co-hosts SHINE, an online salon for working artists. Animals run through much of her writing: The Book of Beasties is a guide to the messages of wild creatures, and Swimming with Elephants tells the story of her move from medicine into healing. Her most recent book is an illustrated workbook on personal boundaries.

books.title: The Book of Beasties
books.author: Sarah Bamford Seidelmann
books.description: An A to Z of wild animals and what each might be saying to the reader, written in her playful style as a way into working with spirit animals.

books.title: Swimming with Elephants: My Unexpected Pilgrimage from Physician to Healer
books.author: Sarah Bamford Seidelmann
books.description: Her memoir of leaving a career in pathology for shamanic work, and of the elephant spirit ally who guided the change.

books.title: How Good Are You Willing to Let It Get
books.author: Sarah Bamford Seidelmann
books.description: A light-hearted book of encouragement written with her elephant ally, inviting readers to allow more joy and ease into their lives.

books.title: Boundaries Make Love Possible
books.author: Sarah Bamford Seidelmann
books.description: An illustrated workbook that grew from her own hundred-day experiment with saying no, with short lessons and prompts for setting kinder limits.

books.title: Where the Deer Dream
books.author: Sarah Bamford Seidelmann
books.description: A visionary novel about a seventeen-year-old girl drawn into an unfamiliar world after an unexpected discovery.

courses.title: Shamanic Healing
courses.description: One-to-one shamanic healing ceremonies that attend to the soul and spirit, held in person or at a distance by phone or video. Single sessions and packages of six are offered.

courses.title: Get SOURCED: A Guided Introduction to the Shamanic Journey
courses.description: A ninety-minute recorded class explaining what shamanism is and guiding beginners through their first journeys to meet helping spirits.

courses.title: SHINE: A Working Creative's Salon
courses.description: A year-round online group for writers, artists and other creatives, co-led with Inger Kenobi, meeting on Zoom every other Tuesday for an hour.

courses.title: Create Your FEELGOOD Morning Routine
courses.description: A recorded class on building a simple stack of morning habits that leave you steadier and more in line with your values.
